name: Check a transcript graph against the skill library, merge it into the knowledge graph, outline skills only for gaps
goal: Compare a video's term graph with the published skill catalog and public prior-art, mark which terms and relations are new, merge everything into a persistent knowledge graph (knowledge/graph.json, references only), and draft skill outlines only where a contiguous run of grounded procedure steps covers 2+ gap items. Each outline gets nearest-skill and novelty verdicts, then goes through distill-transcript -> quality_check -> novelty_check. Delta vs generic dedupe or novelty checks: coverage is judged at the level of params, values, and modulation relations (not just title similarity), and outlines carry timestamped evidence spans instead of free-written steps.

inputs.name: no_kg_update
inputs.description: Dry run: do not write knowledge/graph.json

outputs.name: gap_report
outputs.description: raw/<id>/gaps.json: gap_nodes (with known_in_kg, prior_art counts), gap_edges, coverage maps, candidates, stats

outputs.name: knowledge_graph
outputs.description: knowledge/graph.json: nodes/edges with videos[], refs[{video_id,t}], covered_by[] skill ids

constraints: Transcript source is YouTube's Show transcript panel text (info section -> Transcript); say 'transcript', not 'captions'. Caption-file transports (.srt/.vtt) are only used internally and deleted.
Never invent transcript text, steps, or settings; every downstream fact must trace to a transcript timestamp.
No Whisper/ASR on the audio unless Matt explicitly asks; the router may only FLAG it as a last resort.
Outlines are not skills. Never copy an outline into mcp-publish; it has to pass distill-transcript, quality_check_skill.py and novelty_check_skill.py first.

A node is covered when the same lexicon matches it in a published skill's text; a sets edge only when that skill also has the same value string; an affects edge only when one skill step mentions both endpoints. Structural part-of edges are never gaps.
Outlines from translated transcripts are flagged translated_source=true; the distiller must check numbers and terms against transcript.orig.<lang>.txt.
The knowledge graph stores no quote text (public repo); quotes stay in raw/<id>/graph.json.

steps.action: Build library coverage: run the domain matcher over every published skill's name, goal, steps, constraints, tags and verification. Collect node -> skill ids, value strings -> skill ids, and step-level term pairs -> skill ids.
steps.expect: Coverage maps for nodes, values and pairs

steps.action: For each graph term node (param/module/concept/tool/phrase), mark covered or gap. Tag gaps with known_in_kg (already seen in another video) and prior_art (how many public pack descriptions mention it).
steps.expect: gap_nodes with repeat and generic signals

steps.action: For each sets/affects edge, apply the edge coverage rules. Uncovered edges become gap_edges with their timestamp and evidence quote.

Score each transcript step by gap terms + 2 x gap edges at its timestamp. Group contiguous scored steps (one zero step allowed inside a run, trailing zeros trimmed). Keep runs with >= min_steps steps and >= 2 gap items.

For each span write an outline: candidate_id, name/goal drafts that state the delta, grounded_steps [{t, quote}], gap nodes/edges, nearest_existing (top 3 by token Jaccard blend), and a novelty verdict (NOVEL/REVIEW/WARN_NEAR_DUPLICATE/REJECT_OR_DELTA).

Merge the graph into knowledge/graph.json (add the video, nodes, non-step edges, refs and covered_by), update KG stats, and write gaps.json. Hand outlines to distill-transcript; if there are none, report the video as covered.
steps.expect: KG grows with every video; gaps drive new skills

verification: gaps.json stats show terms_checked, terms_covered, gap_edges and candidates
Every outline has >= 3 grounded_steps with timestamps and a novelty verdict
knowledge/graph.json lists the video under videos{} and has no quote fields
